summary.text: Mike Day is a Democratic state representative from Stoneham who represents the 31st Middlesex District and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney who founded his own law firm in 2012 and chairs the Joint Committee on the Judiciary.

paragraphs.text: Day represents the towns of Stoneham and Winchester and lives in Stoneham with his wife, Megan, and their three sons, according to his legislative biography.
He earned a B.A. from the University of Massachusetts Amherst in 1996 and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center in 2003, and he graduated from Phillips Academy Andover in 1991.
Day worked as a Special Assistant District Attorney in Middlesex County and practiced law at Mintz Levin in Boston for nearly ten years before founding his own law firm in 2012.
He chaired the Boston Bar Association's Civil Rights and Civil Liberties Section in 2014 and was an adjunct law professor at New England School of Law in 2013.
Day chairs the Joint Committee on the Judiciary and also serves on the House Committee on Ethics and the Special Joint Committee on Initiative Petitions.
He has coached Stoneham Youth Hockey since 2010.
